messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” signal-integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but the supported capability set is: high-speed digital and power verification/debugging, transmission-channel validation, insertion loss / crosstalk / eye-diagram analysis, TDR impedance, PCB material/stackup characterization, RefClk/PLL jitter performance, PDN testing, ADC/DAC frontend performance, and cable/connector-related SI testing [2][18][19][92].
### Supported signal-integrity capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters in the cited wireless / high-speed context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-speed digital and power verification/debugging | Mobile network infrastructure includes “Digital Design & Power” as an industry driver, and high-speed digital and power designs are described as needing fast, reliable, accurate T&M tools for verification/debugging [13][92]. | [13][92] |
| VNA, probes, phase-noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source coverage | The wireless infrastructure source lists these as tools for high-speed digital and power design verification/debugging [92]. | [92] |
| Transmission-channel validation across Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, connectors, and test boards | The SerDes/SI source describes high-speed electrical-interface validation challenges around the transmission channel, including Tx/Rx, channel, Tx package, PCBs, connectors, Rx package, measurement path to DUT, and test board development [2][19]. | [2][19] |
| Interface test using scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices | The validation-challenges slide maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [2]. | [2] |
| IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram analysis | The high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow explicitly lists IL, Xtalk, and Eye diagram [2]. | [2] |
| TDR impedance measurement | The same signal-integrity flow lists TDR Impedance, and PCB test solutions list impedance measurement by TDR [2][18]. | [2][18] |
| PCB material and stackup characterization | PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with impedance/TDR and DK/DF extraction, and Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [18]. | [18] |
| Signal-integrity modeling/testing for PCB | PCB test solutions list Signal Integrity modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [18]. | [18] |
| Sampling testing and process monitoring for PCB production | PCB test solutions list Sampling testing with IL, DK/DF, and impedance, and PL/Process Monitoring in the same PCB / high-speed digital test flow [18]. | [18] |
| RefClk and PLL jitter performance | The validation-challenges slide maps RefClk and PLL jitter performance to phase-noise analyzers and signal generators [2]. | [2] |
| Power Distribution Network / power integrity testing | The validation-challenges slide maps Power Distribution Network to scopes and network analyzers, and the wireless infrastructure source treats high-speed digital and power designs as a verification/debugging area [2][92]. | [2][92] |
| ADC / DAC frontend performance | The validation-challenges slide maps ADC / DAC frontend performance to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [2]. | [2] |
| Cable / connector testing and de-embedding-related SI | PCB test solutions include “w/ cable / connector testing,” and high-speed interconnect cases place board-to-board connector DUTs, bare boards, and socket/transmission-line evaluation at the intersection of signal integrity, insertion loss, return loss, impedance, and de-embedding [18][22]. | [18][22] |
### Wireless-communication application context
Wireless-communication infrastructure drivers in the passages include increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming, OTA testing, more spectrum bands / higher frequencies / expanding bandwidth, digital design & power, network energy saving, network densification, private networks, and Open RAN [13][93].
Wireless certification-lab capabilities in the passages focus on RF, EMC, safety, and conformity certification, with major test items including spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, EMI/EMS, ESD, power surge, protocol compatibility, interoperability, and PTCRB/GCF certification [5][60].
【推論】For wireless-communication applications, the SI capabilities most defensible from the passages are the ones that support the “Digital Design & Power” driver in mobile network infrastructure and the high-speed PCB/PCBA validation flow: VNA/probing-based verification, channel/PCB/connector validation, IL/Xtalk/eye/TDR/impedance, jitter, PDN, and ADC/DAC frontend checks [2][18][19][92].

無線通訊認證實驗室 › 重點摘要
本來源是由 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 轉出的 company restricted 簡報，正式發布日期與文件版次未標示；raw frontmatter 顯示 converted 日期為 2026-09-17。

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

主要內容包括：

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 來源稱認證必要性包括防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端與 6G 等需求。
- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。

- `經NCC、TAF、FCC等機構認可` 是簡報概括說法；未列具體實驗室認可證號、有效期限、測試範圍或 accreditation body 文件。
- 台灣 NCC 證書 `5年有效` 的適用產品類別、法規依據與例外情況未標示。
- RF / EMC 測試 `3-4週` 與 GMA `8-12週` 是來源說法，未提供產品類別、樣品狀態、認證地區、測試負載或排隊條件。
- [[耕興]] `30MHz~325GHz`、`108座測試場地`、`連續10年FCC最佳實驗室認證`、`首張Wi-Fi 8證書` 等宣稱未提供官方證書、公告 URL 或日期。
- [[SGS]] 與 [[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]] 的能力描述較粗略，未列場地、頻段、認可標準、標準版本或正式能力表。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › TTC 毫米波測試量能線索
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）介紹[[電信技術中心]]毫米波頻段測試量能：

- 5G FR2 毫米波天線縮距量測場 CATR。
- 來源稱該 chamber 依據 3GPP 技術規範標準，已通過 TAF 認證。
- 可支援主波發射頻段 3–40 GHz。
- 不必要發射至 90 GHz。
- 可量測 TRP、TIS、EVM。
- Quiet Zone 可達 90 cm。

同一來源另描述[[電信技術中心]]提供電信設備審驗認證服務，並協助研擬電信技術標準規範。

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › 已擷取的無線通訊認證實驗室簡報內容
依 [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]：

- [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]用於測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規及一致性認證。
- 來源稱其可經 [[NCC]]、[[TAF]]、[[FCC]] 等機構認可，並支援 [[Global Market Access]] 與上市加速。
- 主要測試項目包含：頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試、[[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 認證必要性包含防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端、6G 等需求。

### Short answer
The passages do not rank “most important” signal-integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but the supported capability set is: high-speed digital and power verification/debugging, transmission-channel validation, insertion loss / crosstalk / eye-diagram analysis, TDR impedance, PCB material/stackup characterization, RefClk/PLL jitter performance, PDN testing, ADC/DAC frontend performance, and cable/connector-related SI testing [2][18][19][92].
### Supported signal-integrity capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters in the cited wireless / high-speed context | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-speed digital and power verification/debugging | Mobile network infrastructure includes “Digital Design & Power” as an industry driver, and high-speed digital and power designs are described as needing fast, reliable, accurate T&M tools for verification/debugging [13][92]. | [13][92] |
| VNA, probes, phase-noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source coverage | The wireless infrastructure source lists these as tools for high-speed digital and power design verification/debugging [92]. | [92] |
| Transmission-channel validation across Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, connectors, and test boards | The SerDes/SI source describes high-speed electrical-interface validation challenges around the transmission channel, including Tx/Rx, channel, Tx package, PCBs, connectors, Rx package, measurement path to DUT, and test board development [2][19]. | [2][19] |
| Interface test using scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices | The validation-challenges slide maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [2]. | [2] |
| IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram analysis | The high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow explicitly lists IL, Xtalk, and Eye diagram [2]. | [2] |
| TDR impedance measurement | The same signal-integrity flow lists TDR Impedance, and PCB test solutions list impedance measurement by TDR [2][18]. | [2][18] |
| PCB material and stackup characterization | PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with impedance/TDR and DK/DF extraction, and Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [18]. | [18] |
| Signal-integrity modeling/testing for PCB | PCB test solutions list Signal Integrity modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [18]. | [18] |
| Sampling testing and process monitoring for PCB production | PCB test solutions list Sampling testing with IL, DK/DF, and impedance, and PL/Process Monitoring in the same PCB / high-speed digital test flow [18]. | [18] |
| RefClk and PLL jitter performance | The validation-challenges slide maps RefClk and PLL jitter performance to phase-noise analyzers and signal generators [2]. | [2] |
| Power Distribution Network / power integrity testing | The validation-challenges slide maps Power Distribution Network to scopes and network analyzers, and the wireless infrastructure source treats high-speed digital and power designs as a verification/debugging area [2][92]. | [2][92] |
| ADC / DAC frontend performance | The validation-challenges slide maps ADC / DAC frontend performance to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [2]. | [2] |
| Cable / connector testing and de-embedding-related SI | PCB test solutions include “w/ cable / connector testing,” and high-speed interconnect cases place board-to-board connector DUTs, bare boards, and socket/transmission-line evaluation at the intersection of signal integrity, insertion loss, return loss, impedance, and de-embedding [18][22]. | [18][22] |
### Wireless-communication application context
Wireless-communication infrastructure drivers in the passages include increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming, OTA testing, more spectrum bands / higher frequencies / expanding bandwidth, digital design & power, network energy saving, network densification, private networks, and Open RAN [13][93].
Wireless certification-lab capabilities in the passages focus on RF, EMC, safety, and conformity certification, with major test items including spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, EMI/EMS, ESD, power surge, protocol compatibility, interoperability, and PTCRB/GCF certification [5][60].
【推論】For wireless-communication applications, the SI capabilities most defensible from the passages are the ones that support the “Digital Design & Power” driver in mobile network infrastructure and the high-speed PCB/PCBA validation flow: VNA/probing-based verification, channel/PCB/connector validation, IL/Xtalk/eye/TDR/impedance, jitter, PDN, and ADC/DAC frontend checks [2][18][19][92].

依 [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]：

- [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]用於測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規及一致性認證。
- 來源稱其可經 [[NCC]]、[[TAF]]、[[FCC]] 等機構認可，並支援 [[Global Market Access]] 與上市加速。
- 主要測試項目包含：頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試、[[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 認證必要性包含防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端、6G 等需求。

- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。
